newsitem.title: SPAIN: TENNIS-MOYA SEALS GERMANY'S DAVIS CUP FATE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MOYA SEALS GERMANY'S DAVIS CUP FATE.

text.p: Carlos Moya sealed Germany's exit from the first round of the Davis Cup on Sunday when he overpowered Hendrik Dreekman to give Spain an unbeatable 3-1 lead in their world group tie.
Spain will play Italy, winners this weekend over Mexico, in the second round in April.
Australian Open finalist Moya broke Dreekman's serve in the opening games of the first two sets and again at the end of the third to win 6-4 6-4 7-5.

Dreekman had broken back to 1-1 in the second set but then saw a lob that would have given him a further break land just out. Moya survived the scare and won the game with a superb backhand crosscourt pass, before breaking serve again at 3-3.
Moya and Albert Costa both won their singles matches on Friday but former champions Germany fought back in Saturday's doubles.
Albert Costa and Marc Goellner were set to play the final, dead rubber later on Sunday.
